New eighth rule receipt_commit_artifacts verifies the receipt offline from the local object store (git ls-tree + cat-file, no network): 40-hex commit must resolve, every bound path must exist in that commit's tree, every blob sha256 must equal the manifest's, and the digest recomputed from those blobs must equal validated_head_sha; git unavailable, non-repo --git-root, ls-tree failure, or cat-file failure on a known-present path all fail closed. Path absence comes from ls-tree membership, not cat-file message substrings. New --git-root defaults to --repo-root so a staging dir fails closed instead of reading other history. The exact regression asserts the rejection set on the doctored manifest is exactly {receipt_commit_artifacts}, which is simultaneously proof the other seven pass, and it reports both the 9ac925e0 digest conflict and both absent validator scripts; a second regression rebinds the worktree to 5c39428's v4 bytes so head_binding and companion_checksum pass and only the git read objects.
